+title: 'acp-client N3+N4: --frames and probe'
+---
+### What
+
+Upstream work in `../FoundationModelsACPClient`, milestones **N3** and
+**N4** of its `cli-plan.md`.
+
+**N3 — `--frames`.** Write every ndJSON message to stderr, in both
+directions, with a direction mark. This is the reason the binary exists:
+it shows the protocol exchange, so a person can see what an agent sent.
+stdout stays the answer text alone.
+
+**N4 — `probe`.** Start the agent, initialize, and print what it
+reports: the protocol version, the agent capabilities, the
+authentication methods, and the slash commands. Run no turn. Its report
+**is** its output, so it goes to stdout. `--json` prints the same report
+as JSON. It exits 0 whenever the agent answers — the verdict belongs to
+`doctor`, not here.
+
+- [ ] `--frames`, on stderr, both directions
+- [ ] `probe`, and its `--json` form
+- [ ] `probe` runs no turn
+
+### Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `--frames` writes the messages to stderr, and stdout stays clean.
+- [ ] `probe` prints the stub agent's protocol version, capabilities,
+      authentication methods and slash commands.
+- [ ] `probe` sends no `session/prompt`.
+- [ ] `probe --json` decodes to the same values as the human form.
+- [ ] `probe` exits 0 for any agent that answers `initialize`.
+
+### Tests
+
+- [ ] `--frames` against the stub agent: the captured stderr holds both
+      directions, and the captured stdout holds only the answer.
+- [ ] `probe` against the stub agent: the report names each field, and
+      the recording client shows no `session/prompt` was sent.
+- [ ] `probe --json` decodes and equals the human form's values.
+- [ ] `swift test` in `../FoundationModelsACPClient` passes.
+
+### Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

     This card stays open until that one is done and merged to ACPClient `main`.
   timestamp: 2026-09-08T22:24:32.674648+00:00
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m21vh59y1ryhqrg2s2v2c70q
+  text: |
+    ### Verification of the upstream work
+
+    This card is a tracking card. The work is in `../FoundationModelsACPClient`,
+    card `^yq1sndy`, which is in `done` and merged to that repository's `main`.
+    I read the code and the tests on `main` (HEAD `a11baae`). Related commits:
+    `b8343db` ("test(cli): prove probe --json decodes to the human form's
+    values") and `4f990f8`.
+
+    **`--frames` writes both directions to stderr, and stdout stays clean.**
+    - `Sources/AcpClientCore/FrameTeeTransport.swift` is a pass-through
+      transport. It marks each agent line `"<< "` and each client line `">> "`,
+      and it sends each line to a sink.
+    - `Sources/AcpClientCore/RunCommand.swift`, member
+      `sessionTransport(over:frames:terminal:)`, wraps the agent stdio in that
+      tee when the command line carries `--frames`, and points the sink at
+      `TerminalOutput.frame(_:)`.
+    - `Sources/AcpClientCore/TerminalOutput.swift`, member `frame(_:)`, writes
+      through `writeToStandardError(_:)`, which writes to
+      `FileHandle.standardError`. Nothing in the frame path writes to stdout.
+    - `SharedOptions.swift` declares the `--frames` flag for every subcommand.
+    - Test: `IntegrationTests/.../StreamRulesTests.swift`,
+      `framesWritesEveryMessageToStandardError`. It asserts the exit code, that
+      stdout holds the answer bytes and nothing more, that one outbound line
+      carries the `initialize` request, that one inbound line carries the
+      agent's session id, and that the count of marked lines equals the count of
+      all stderr lines.
+    - Test: `IntegrationTests/.../DoctorCommandTests.swift`,
+      `framesLeavesTheReportOnStandardOutputUnchanged`, compares the stdout
+      bytes with and without the flag.
+    - Unit tests: `Tests/.../FrameTeeTransportTests.swift` and
+      `RunCommandTransportTests.swift`.
+
+    **`probe` exists, and `probe --json` too.**
+    - `Sources/AcpClientCore/ProbeCommand.swift` and `ProbeReport.swift`.
+    - `AcpClient.swift` lists `ProbeCommand.self` in its subcommands.
+    - The `--json` flag is `ReportOptions` in `SharedOptions.swift`, which
+      `probe` and `doctor` embed and `run` does not.
+    - `ProbeCommand.write(_:asJSON:)` writes the report to
+      `FileHandle.standardOutput`, in the plain form or the JSON form.
+    - The report holds the protocol version, the capabilities, the
+      authentication methods and the slash commands.
+    - Test: `IntegrationTests/.../ProbeCommandTests.swift`,
+      `theReportNamesEveryPartTheAgentReported` and
+      `theJSONFormParsesAndThePlainFormIsNotJSON`.
+
+    **`probe` sends no `session/prompt`.**
+    - `ProbeCommand.buildReport(with:)` calls `initialize()`, `openSession()`,
+      reads the command list, then `closeSession(_:)`. It sends no prompt.
+    - Test: `ProbeCommandTests.probeRunsNoTurnAndClosesItsSession` records what
+      the stub agent read and asserts the record holds no `session/prompt` and
+      does hold `session/close`.
+
+    **`probe --json` decodes to the same values as the human form.**
+    - Test: `ProbeCommandTests.theJSONFormDecodesToTheValuesTheHumanFormPrints`
+      (commit `b8343db`). It decodes the JSON stdout into `ProbeReport` and
+      compares the values with the stub agent's values and with the plain form's
+      stdout.
+
+    **`probe` exits 0 for any agent that answers `initialize`.**
+    - Test: `ProbeCommandTests` asserts exit code 0 in each success test,
+      including `theTwoEmptyCommandStatesReadDifferently`, where the agent
+      reports an empty command list and where it reports none.
+
+    **The upstream test suites pass.** The `^yq1sndy` step record says:
+    `swift test` 227 tests in 20 suites passed, and
+    `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests` 92 tests in 13 suites passed,
+    with 0 warnings. Its review step found 0 findings.
+
+    I made no change in `../FoundationModelsACPClient`, and no code change in
+    this repository. This card only records the verification.
+  timestamp: 2026-09-09T01:11:47.262542+00:00
